scenes.headline: How DeepGEMM keeps an eight-bit matrix multiply honest
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Tungsten! Let me show you the two numerical tricks inside DeepSeek's matrix multiply library.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Give every run of 128 elements its own scale, and empty the tensor core's accumulator into the wider CUDA core registers every 128 steps.
scenes.say: Give every run of a hundred and twenty eight elements its own scale, and empty the tensor core's accumulator into wider registers just as often.

scenes.title: Choosing a scale for eight-bit numbers

left.title: One for the tensor
left.say: With one scale for the whole tensor, the largest value sets it, and the quiet values sink toward the bottom of the format.

right.title: One per 128
right.say: With one scale for every group, an outlier only spoils its own neighbours. The price is that the scale now changes inside the dot product.

scenes.title: One block of K, end to end

steps.say: One warp does nothing but issue copies, pulling the next tile of activations and weights toward the chip.
The tiles land in shared memory a stage ahead, so the maths never waits on memory.
The tensor core multiplies them, accumulating in a register that keeps only about fourteen bits.
Every hundred and twenty eight elements the partial sum is handed to the CUDA cores, scaled there, and added in full precision.
Two groups of maths warps take turns, so one is adding while the other multiplies, and the tensor cores never idle.

scenes.label: what the tensor core accumulator keeps
scenes.say: This is the number the whole design turns on. Fourteen bits, where the output format has twenty four.

steps.say: The loading warps keep three copies in flight at once, each issue overlapping the one before it.
Below them the two maths groups alternate: multiply, then promote, staggered so the two never collide.

scenes.text: The clever parts aged out. The two facts about the hardware did not.
scenes.say: The hand-written assembly patch lasted about a year before the compiler absorbed it. The numerics underneath are still the whole design.
A scale for every group, a promotion to wider adds, and warps arranged so nothing waits.
